story.titleZh: 法拉利是否在自毁前程？意大利大奖赛评析
story.summaryZh: 法拉利在主场蒙扎的意大利大奖赛上未能真正进入状态，两位车手在一号弯发生碰撞，刘易斯·汉密尔顿的沮丧情绪也随周末推移逐渐显现。赛后焦点在于法拉利是否难堪、是否正在错失争夺总冠军的机会。
story.originalTitle: Is Ferrari shooting itself in the foot? Our Italian GP verdict
story.summaryEn: Ferrari never really got going at its home Italian Grand Prix at Monza, with its drivers clashing at the first corner and Lewis Hamilton's frustrations bubbling to the surface as the weekend went on. The Race assesses whether Ferrari embarrassed itself and is fumbling a title shot.
detailZh: 法拉利的主场一级方程式比赛总是带来额外的压力，但事实是，它在意大利大奖赛上始终没能真正进入状态。
其实，这么说可能还算客气了；因为它的两名车手在第一个弯角就发生了碰撞，而随着周末的进行，刘易斯·汉密尔顿的沮丧情绪也逐渐浮出水面。
法拉利让自己难堪了吗？它是不是正在搞砸一次争夺总冠军的机会——或者这个机会本来就从未存在过？在基米·安东内利从后往前超车、再次赢得分站冠军之后，车手总冠军之争现在又是什么局面？
以下是我们在蒙扎周末结束后的一些看法。
两位法拉利车手都需要为一号弯和二号弯的那些骚操作承担一些责任：汉密尔顿应该为内线切入勒克莱尔负责，而勒克莱尔则因为没有留出足够空间而负有责任。
勒克莱尔说“我们做得太过分了”是对的，因为法拉利正用这种队内竞争的方式搬起石头砸自己的脚。
他们似乎总是并排缠斗，就像在进行一场只有他们两人的总冠军争夺战一样。
相反，他们未能像本可以做到的那样通力合作——我把法拉利对比赛中各种局面的管理也包括在内——这使得本就希望渺茫的总冠军之争变得更加遥不可及。
我们是否正在见证F1的下一位纪录保持者？
随着安东内利的比赛场数不断累积，这个锦标赛对他来说越来越像是他不能丢掉的比赛，而不是别人能从他手中抢走的比赛。
他上周刚满20岁，在蒙扎从第19位发车并最终夺冠，期间既没有撞掉前翼，也没有陷入沙石缓冲区，这展现出年龄带给他的成熟。继续保持这种势头，我非常确定他所积累的总冠军数量将能达到超越迈克尔·舒马赫和刘易斯·汉密尔顿的水平，他们两人都手握七个总冠军。
是的，他确实有一次冲出赛道，可能还有几次我们没有注意到的小失误，但总体来说，在主场观众的压力面前，这是一次近乎完美的驾驶。当法拉利显然没有一辆能登上领奖台的车之后，车迷们（tifosi）真正地转而支持了他——对一位意大利车手来说，在蒙扎夺冠是60年来的第一次，这场胜利将永远伴随他，而他的支持者现在大概翻了十倍。
关于拉塞尔因为在虚拟安全车期间没有进站而吃亏的说法全是胡扯，我很确定换作我也会做出同样的进站决策。拉塞尔当时用的是硬胎，打算硬撑到比赛结束，而安东内利用的是中性胎，所以要把轮胎撑到最后对他来说会更艰难一点，大概还要撑到最后五圈左右。换上一套全新的中性胎进站让他丢了赛道位置，因此他必须把车推到极限去追回损失的时间，连同赛道位置一起追回来。
如果说有什么我想跟他说一说的，那就是领跑时在最后一圈去刷最快圈。是的，展示自己还藏着什么底牌确实令人印象深刻，但完全没有必要，所以博诺（Bono）得跟他说两句。
真要说吃亏的话，倒是安东内利——他用硬胎起步，本打算跑长距离——因为早早出动的红旗而吃了亏，所以实际上除了换上中性胎以满足必须使用两种干地轮胎配方的规定之外，他别无选择。
至于法拉利，第一圈第一个减速弯时车队内部的小摩擦——我个人认为是汉密尔顿对队友有点强硬——再加上勒克莱尔在抛物线弯（Parabolica）出弯时撞车，让两辆车争夺领奖台席位的任何可能性都化为泡影。实际上我认为法拉利本来就没有速度，所以它需要吃一点低调的苦头，承认自己还有工作要做。
我很确定，又是一个赛季、又一个总冠军，都是“本应该、本可以、本能够”——但最终没做到，因为赛车不够好。
对拉塞尔来说，这将是一个尤其难以接受的沉重打击，他本带着缩小与安东内利积分差距的期待来到这个周末，结果却眼睁睁看着差距被进一步拉大。
不过，他不必对自己太过苛责。首先，这里存在一个新/旧引擎之间的性能差距，这或许解释了为什么我们听到他们在降温室里说，比赛中两人使用了不同的引擎模式。
而且，尽管安东内利凭借一场出色的追赶之战理应获得赞誉，他从第19位发车最终夺冠，在很大程度上得益于夏尔·勒克莱尔的撞车，以及兰斯·斯特罗尔的阿斯顿·马丁抛锚所引发的虚拟安全车。
红旗实际上让这变成了一场从第12位发车而非第19位起步的胜利，而虚拟安全车则让安东内利用上了新得多的轮胎，相比正常情况下少损失了约10秒的比赛时间。
如果这场比赛正常运行，也许安东内利凭借他那些犀利的超车动作并借助新动力单元的优势仍能获得第二名，但我不确定在一场完全公平的较量中他是否还能击败拉塞尔。
拉塞尔需要把这个结果归档处理，并尽量将其与自己自身的表现区分开来——尽管这场景看起来有点像当年刘易斯·汉密尔顿在蒙扎屡屡碾压队友瓦尔特利·博塔斯的日子。
我不禁觉得这个结果有一种必然性。即使剩下的比赛场次还足够多，安东内利仍可能出现闪失，让你无法真正断言总冠军之争已经结束，但关于哪位车手是本赛季表现最出色车手的争论，恐怕已经有了答案。
而周日的比赛也让我不禁感到有些缺憾。我知道我们现在正处于'规则就是这样，也只能接受'的阶段，直到明年才会改变，所以我不想在这上面纠结太久——大家或多或少都已经对这套规则感到厌倦了。
这感觉与前一天皮埃尔·加斯利夺得杆位时那让人从座位上跳起来、喊出'我靠！'的瞬间相比，实在是一个巨大的落差和反差。
尽管这与我们在蒙扎惯常见到的场面有些不同，但比赛其实并没有带来多少新鲜感：那些你来我往的直道超越——虽然这么说有点老套，但这样的场面确实配不上'速度殿堂'的名号。
detailEn: Ferrari's home Formula 1 race always brings added pressure, but the truth is it never really got going at the Italian Grand Prix.
In fact, that's maybe being a little generous; as its drivers came to blows at the first corner and Lewis Hamilton's frustrations bubbled to the surface as the weekend went on.
Did it embarrass itself? Is Ferrari fumbling a title shot - or was that never even on? And what state is the drivers' title fight in after Kimi Antonelli's drive through the field to yet another win?
Here's our thoughts at the end of the Monza weekend.
Both Ferrari drivers need to take some responsibility for the Turn 1/2 shenanigans: Hamilton for diving down the inside of Leclerc and Leclerc for not leaving enough room.
Leclerc is right to say "we went too far" because Ferrari is shooting itself in the foot with team-mates racing like this.
They seem to race wheel-to-wheel like they're in an exclusive title fight.
Instead, not working together as well as they could - I include Ferrari's management of racing situations within this - is making a long shot title bid an even longer one.
Are we watching F1's next record holder?
As the races count down for Antonelli, it is becoming more of a championship for him to lose than one that someone will beat him to.

He did turn 20 last week, and at Monza driving from 19th to win without losing a front wing or ending up stuck in the gravel trap shows the maturity that age has brought to him. Keep on building on that and I'm pretty sure the championships will build to a level that could outdo both Michael Schumacher and Lewis Hamilton, who both have seven championships in the bag.

Yes, he did have one excursion for sure and probably a few more small one that we didn't really see, but in general it was a faultless drive in front of the pressure of his home crowd. Once it was evident that Ferrari just didn't have the car to get on the podium the tifosi really got behind him - and that win at Monza for an Italian, which is the first for 60 years, will be with him forever and his supports are probably now tenfold.

It's all rubbish about Russell losing out by not pitting under the VSC and I'm pretty sure I would have done the same pitcall. Russell was on the hard tyre intending to brave it out to the end, Antonelli was on the medium so it would have been just that little bit more difficult for him to get them to the finish, perhaps for the final five laps or so. Pitting for a fresh set of mediums lost him track position so he needed to push to the limit to regain that lost time and with it track position.

One thing I would have a word with him about is doing the fastest lap on the last lap while leading. Yes, it's impressive to show what you have up your sleeve but totally unnecessary, so Bono have a word.

If anything, Antonelli who started on the hards - intending to go long - lost out with the early red flag so in reality he had no choice other than going to a medium compound to comply with the two-compound dry-race requirement.

As for Ferrari, its little intra-team skirmish at the first chicane on the first lap - which I personally think was Hamilton being a bit bullish with his team-mate - and then Leclerc's crash coming out of the Parabolica scuppered any potential of either of its two cars challenging for a podium. In reality I don't think Ferrari had the pace anyway so it needs to eat a bit of humble pie and accept it has work to do.
I'm pretty sure it's another season and another championship of should've, could've, would've - but didn't because the car isn’t good enough.
This will be an especially tough blow to take for Russell, who would have come into this weekend expecting to slash his points deficit to Antonelli and ended up seeing it extended.

But, he needn't be too hard on himself. Firstly, there's a new/old engine offset there, which is perhaps why we heard them say in the cooldown room that they were using different strat modes during the race.

And, although Antonelli will rightly get plaudits for an excellent recovery drive, his victory from 19th on the grid was significantly aided by Charles Leclerc's crash and the VSC caused by Lance Stroll's Aston Martin conking out.
The red flag effectively made this a win from 12th on the grid rather than 19th, and the VSC gave Antonelli much fresher tyres with about 10 seconds fewer of race time lost compared to normal.

Had this race run normally, perhaps Antonelli still finishes second with all that incisive overtaking he did with taking the benefit of that new power unit, but I'm not sure he still beats Russell in a completely straight fight.

Russell will need to compartmentalise this outcome and try to disassociate it from his own performance - even though it looked a bit like the days when Lewis Hamilton used to devour team-mate Valtteri Bottas at Monza.

I couldn't help but feel there was a sense of inevitability about that result. And even if there are enough races left for something to go wrong for Antonelli that you can't truly say the title race is done, the debate over which driver's been the most impressive this season probably is.

And I couldn't help but feel shortchanged by Sunday's race either. I know we're in the 'we're stuck with this, it is what it is' phase of this ruleset now until next year, so I won't dwell too long on that - we've all grown tired of that in one way or another.
It just felt like quite a comedown from - and contrast to - the out-of-the-seat, 'oh f***!' moment that Pierre Gasly's pole position offered a day earlier.

Even if this was something a little different to what we're used to at Monza, it didn't really move the needle any more: the drive-by passes back-and-forth - it just didn't seem very fitting, cliched though it is, for the Temple of Speed.
keyPointsZh: 法拉利的两位车手在比赛第一弯发生碰撞。
汉密尔顿的沮丧情绪在比赛周末过程中逐渐浮现。
安东内利从后场超越对手，拿下又一场胜利。
keyPointsEn: Ferrari's drivers came to blows at the first corner of the race.
Kimi Antonelli drove through the field to claim yet another win.

relatedItems.originalTitle: F1 2026 Qatar Grand Prix qualifying results
detailZh: 乔治·拉塞尔夺得杆位，梅赛德斯车队在卡塔尔大奖赛排位赛中占据领先，这是自5月份加拿大大奖赛以来的首次。
以下是排位赛三部分的全部结果：
11 Ollie 贝尔曼 (哈斯) 1m23.367s +0.240s (与Q3差距)
17 塞恩斯 (威廉姆斯) 1m24.370s +0.096s (与Q2差距)
19 安东内利·阿隆索 (阿斯顿·马丁) +0.436秒
detailEn: George Russell claimed pole position as Mercedes dominated Qatar Grand Prix qualifying for its first one-two since the Canadian Grand Prix in May.
Here are the full results from all three parts of qualifying:
11 Ollie Bearman (Haas) 1m23.367s +0.240s (gap to Q3)
17 Carlos Sainz (Williams) 1m24.370s +0.096s (gap to Q2)

relatedItems.titleZh: 安东内利与梅赛德斯包揽卡塔尔大奖赛练习赛
relatedItems.summaryZh: 基米·安东内利在卡塔尔大奖赛FP3练习赛中连续三次夺冠，梅赛德斯竞争对手似乎在争夺最佳非梅赛德斯车队，红牛在第三次练习赛中取得第三名。
relatedItems.originalTitle: Antonelli and Mercedes sweep Qatar GP practice
detailZh: 基米·安东内利在卡塔尔大奖赛FP3练习赛中连续三次夺冠，梅赛德斯竞争对手似乎在争夺最佳非梅赛德斯车队，红牛在第三次练习赛中取得第三名。
在排位赛前的20分钟内，练习赛中的圈数非常少。似乎很少有车手能在他们的第一次排位赛中取得更好的成绩。
安东内利的队友乔治·拉塞尔在第二阶段的表现中保持了领先，尽管他在著名的14号弯角发生了一次打滑，那里的地板损坏总是令人担忧，这使安东内利得以缩小到落后0.017秒。
但在第三次尝试中，安东内利全速前进，逆转了排名，领先拉塞尔0.249秒，这个成绩无人能及。
梅赛德斯的车手在任何时刻都落后了半秒左右，红牛车队的马克斯·维斯塔潘在练习结束时排名第三，落后安东内利0.510秒。
维斯塔潘的队友伊萨克·哈德贾排名第四，领先略有提升的法拉利车手查尔斯·勒克莱尔，勒克莱尔在周五的比赛中表现不佳，非常悲观。
勒克莱尔的队友刘易斯·汉密尔顿排名第九，抱怨赛车转向不足，并要求增加前翼角度以避免提前进站。
奥斯卡·皮亚斯蒂在最后一次性能测试跑之前排名第三，但在第六和第七位时被麦凯轮车队的兰多·诺里斯超越，最终排名下降。
皮亚斯特里是众多抱怨转向不足的车手之一。
小红牛在周五表现得非常乐观，并在FP3练习中领跑中游，Arvid Lindblad排名第八，劳森排名第十，领先其中游对手两十分。
阿尔派恩落后小红牛很多，小红牛在车队积分榜上领先Enstone车队27分，争夺第五名。加斯利在FP3练习中排名第14，队友科拉平托排名第16。
科拉平托在最后阶段幸运地避开了高速移动的斯特罗尔，这一事件将在练习结束后进行调查。
在劳森和加斯利之间是奥迪和哈斯车队的奥利·贝尔曼，他的队友拉斐尔·卡马拉排名第15。
费尔南多·阿隆索超越了两辆威廉姆斯赛车，为阿斯顿·马丁赢得了第17名。
凯迪拉克车队以瓦尔特里·博塔斯领先近0.7秒的成绩，排在最后一名塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯之前。
第17名 费尔南多·阿隆索（阿斯顿·马丁）+2.696秒
detailEn: Kimi Antonelli completed a hat-trick of practice sweeps in FP3 for the Qatar Grand Prix, as Mercedes' rivals appear to be fighting for the best of the rest with Red Bull taking that honour in third practice.
Very few laps were turned in the first 20 minutes or so, before qualifying runs. It appeared that few drivers could improve on their first qualifying efforts.

Antonelli's team-mate George Russell set the early pace and maintained that lead after the second performance runs despite a wide moment through the notorious Turn 14 - where floor damage is always a worry - and that allowed Antonelli to close in to just 0.017s behind.
But on the third attempts, Antonelli turned on the afterburners to flip the order and lead Russell by 0.249s, which would not be beaten.
Mercedes' challengers were regularly around half a second down at any given point, with Red Bull's Max Verstappen taking third at the end of the session, 0.510s adrift of Antonelli.
Verstappen's team-mate Isack Hadjar took fourth ahead of the slightly improved Ferrari of Charles Leclerc, who was very pessimistic after Friday's running.
Leclerc's team-mate Lewis Hamilton was down in ninth, complaining that the car was not turning in sufficiently and asking for more front wing angle to avoid understeer.
Oscar Piastri had been third before the last performance run attempt, but was jumped by McLaren team-mate Lando Norris as they ran sixth and seventh, shuffled down the order by the end.
Piastri was another of the many drivers complaining of understeer.
Racing Bulls was extremely bullish on Friday and did head the midfield in FP3 with Arvid Lindblad in eighth and Liam Lawson in 10th, two tenths clear of its midfield rivals.

Alpine was well behind Racing Bulls, which is 27 points ahead of the Enstone team in the chase for fifth in the constructors' standings. Pierre Gasly finished 14th and team-mate Franco Colapinto 16th in FP3.
Colapinto was lucky to avoid a slow-moving Lance Stroll at high speed in the closing stages and that incident will be investigated after the session.
Between Lawson and Gasly were the Audis and Haas driver Ollie Bearman, whose team-mate Rafael Camara finished 15th.
Fernando Alonso cleared both Williams to take 17th for Aston Martin.
Cadillac anchored the order with Valtteri Bottas nearly 0.7s ahead of last-place Sergio Perez.
17 Fernando Alonso (Aston Martin) +2.696s
keyPointsZh: 梅赛德斯竞争对手在练习赛中落后梅赛德斯约半秒。
keyPointsEn: Mercedes' challengers were around half a second behind at any given point.

relatedItems.titleZh: 韩泰启动F1轮胎测试并接触车队，准备竞标2029年供应合同
relatedItems.summaryZh: 韩泰已启动F1轮胎测试计划并与车队展开谈判，准备竞标从2029年起成为F1官方轮胎供应商。F1当前与倍耐力的合同持续到2028年底。
relatedItems.originalTitle: Hankook emerges with serious F1 tyre supply push
relatedItems.summaryEn: Hankook has begun a Formula 1 tyre testing programme and opened talks with teams as it prepares to bid to become the official F1 tyre supplier from 2029. F1's current contract with Pirelli runs until the end of 2028.
detailZh: 据The Race了解，韩泰已启动一项F1轮胎测试计划，并与车队展开谈判，为竞标从2029年起成为大奖赛官方供应商做准备。
F1目前与倍耐力的合同持续到2028年底。此前，这家意大利公司击败普利司通的竞争性报价，赢得了F1最近一次招标合同，覆盖2025至2027年。
今年6月，在国际汽联行使选择权后，其合同又延长了一个赛季。
然而，从2029年起，国际汽联将启动新的招标程序，届时似乎将出现新的竞争，以争夺F1官方供应商资格。
据了解，倍耐力希望先等待看到招标细节，然后再决定是否参与竞标，以延长其自2011年以来的当前合约期，而普利司通长期以来一直在评估重返F1的可能性，其代表已出席过多场比赛。
然而，现在有消息显示，韩泰也准备加入竞争，并且一直在暗中加大自身的努力。
该公司的代表被发现出现在最近的拉斯维加斯大奖赛上，据了解，这是他们继9月前往马德里之后，今年第二次造访F1比赛。
据The Race了解，韩泰利用这些行程会见了大多数车队，并与老板、首席执行官和其他高级管理人员讨论了计划。
然而，前往各地观看比赛——其中还包括2025年在中国、日本和新加坡举行的赛事——只是其为2029年做准备的努力的一方面。
据了解，韩泰已在公司内部组建了一支44人的专项工作组，为进入F1做准备。
除了投入研发能力和模拟器运行之外，该公司今年还使用一辆改装的F2同级测试车完成了两次F1轮胎开发测试，以评估潜在的轮胎结构以及不同配方。
第三次测试已安排用于研发其雨地轮胎，该公司希望这也能帮助其开发出一款具有更窄水雾羽流的轮胎，以减少湿地条件下造成的能见度问题。
韩泰也在努力进行生产和制造规划，以满足任何轮胎招标合同下供应F1、F2和F3轮胎所需。
韩泰对国际汽联的赛事当然并不陌生，这家韩国公司已经是世界拉力锦标赛的官方轮胎供应商，并且刚刚结束了对电动方程式锦标赛的供应，而普利司通将在即将到来的赛季接替。今年早些时候，韩泰还被指定为该管理机构的全球合作伙伴。
2029年之后的新F1轮胎招标期几乎肯定会涵盖向下一个规则时代的过渡，F1正着眼于更轻、更灵活的新赛车，以配合从2030年开始改用V8动力单元。
这些计划还将包括一种新的轮胎设计，该设计将比目前的18英寸设计略微减小车轮尺寸。
detailEn: Hankook has begun a Formula 1 tyre testing programme and opened talks with teams as it prepares to bid on becoming grand prix racing’s official supplier from 2029, The Race has learned.

F1’s current contract with Pirelli runs until the end of 2028, after the Italian company won F1’s most recent tender deal, which covered the period from 2025-2027, against a rival bid from Bridgestone.
Its contract was extended by a further season in June this year after an option was taken up by the FIA.
From 2029, however, a new tender process is set to be launched by the FIA and there looks set to be fresh competition to secure the right to be the official F1 supplier.

It is understood that Pirelli wants to wait to see details of the tender before deciding if it enters the fray to extend its current spell which stretches back to 2011, while Bridgestone has long evaluated an F1 return with representatives having attended races.
However, it has now emerged that Hankook is ready to throw its hat into the ring too and has been secretly ramping up its own efforts.
Representatives of the company were spotted at the recent Las Vegas Grand Prix, which was understood to have been their second visit to an F1 race this year following a trip to Madrid in September.
The Race understands that Hankook has used these trips to meet a majority of teams and discuss plans with bosses, CEOs and other senior executives.
The trips to races, which also included visits to events in China, Japan and Singapore in 2025, are only one side of its efforts to get ready for 2029, however.
It is understood that Hankook has already committed a 44-person task force within the company to prepare for an F1 entry.

Beyond committing research and development capability plus simulator running, it has this year completed two development tests for F1 rubber using a modified F2-equivalent-mule car to evaluate potential construction as well as different compounds.

A third test has been scheduled to work on its wet-weather rubber, which it hopes can also help it develop a tyre that features a narrower spray plume to reduce visibility problems caused in wet conditions.
Hankook is also working hard on production and manufacturing planning that would be required to supply F1, F2 and F3 tyres that would come under the umbrella of any tyre tender contract.

Hankook is certainly no stranger to FIA competition, with the South Korean company already the official tyre supplier to the World Rally Championship and has just ended its supply to Formula E where Bridgestone is taking over for the upcoming season. Earlier this year Hankook was also named as a global partner of the governing body.

The period of the new F1 tyre tender beyond 2029 will almost certainly cover the transition to the next rules era, with F1 setting sights on new lighter and nimbler cars to coincide with the switch to V8 power units from 2030.
The plans are also set to include a new tyre design, which is set to reduce wheel size slightly from the current 18-inch design.
keyPointsZh: 倍耐力在击败普利司通的竞争性报价后赢得2025至2027年的F1轮胎供应合同，今年6月国际汽联行使选择权将合同延长一个赛季。
国际汽联将从2029年起启动新的招标程序，届时预计将出现新的竞争以争夺F1官方供应商资格。
